title: CLEVA: Chinese Language Models EVAluation Platform

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating demographic representation and stereotypical associations with adjectives or profession terms in generated text, classifying whether a given text is biased using the CDial-Bias dataset, and measuring fairness through worst-case accuracy under gender term perturbations.
Evaluating demographic representation and stereotypical associations in generated text, and asking the model to classify whether a given text is biased using data from the CDial-Bias dataset.
Evaluating the model's ability to classify whether a given text contains regional bias using samples from the CDial-Bias dataset.

Evaluating the model's ability to classify whether a given text contains occupational bias using samples from the CDial-Bias dataset, and measuring stereotypical associations with occupational roles in generated text.
Measuring disparate impact (fairness) through worst-case accuracy under prompt transformations, specifically Simplified to Traditional Chinese conversion and Mandarin to Cantonese translation.
Measuring fairness through worst-case accuracy when randomly substituting all occurrences of a Chinese name with another feasible Chinese name.
